notes: Open, removed, or pulled-out states are treated as on; closed or reseated states are treated as off. The two leaves of each double-door upper cabinet are reported separately. Their individual ordering is less certain because both leaves change within one or two eight-frame sampling intervals.
scene_description: A head-mounted camera moves around a residential kitchen while the user sequentially opens and closes the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates three countertop-appliance lids or drawers.
